heading: Uniforms, textbooks, and transportation allowances
lead: The Secretary of Transportation shall provide cadets at the United States Merchant Marine Academy—

tree.text: all required uniforms and textbooks; and
allowances for transportation (including reimbursement of traveling expenses) when traveling under orders as a cadet.
